Since `tp` initially points to `tmp[0]`, `--tp` makes `tp` point to `tmp[-1]` (out of bounds) and `colonp` points to that same location. This is a buffer underflow/overflow issue right at the start. `tmp` is a local array of size 16. `tp` starts at `&tmp[0]`. `--tp` decrements the pointer before it is used. So `colonp` points to memory before `tmp`.
